summary: Learn pension duration, DV01, yield curve stress testing and LDI analysis. Review the course outline and build practical rate-risk reporting skills.
lede: Interest rate risk in pension fund management is assessed by tracing how yield-curve changes affect pension liabilities, assets and funding. For pension investment analysts, actuaries and treasury specialists, this training covers mapping cash flows, calculating duration, convexity and DV01, and building key-rate exposure profiles. Participants also test curve scenarios, assess hedge coverage and liquidity considerations, and prepare monitoring thresholds and committee risk reports using illustrative data and Excel.
audienceIntro: This intermediate course is designed for professionals who already work with pension liabilities, investment portfolios or funding analysis and need to assess how interest rate movements affect them. It suits practitioners who prepare valuation inputs, monitor fixed-income assets or present pension risk findings to investment committees.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with pension fund investments, defined-benefit liabilities or actuarial valuation outputs. You should be comfortable reading basic bond and funding information. No coding or programming is required.
